blocks.heading: Questions 1-2
blocks.title: The Last Ferry of the Season
paragraphs: The ferry between the island and the mainland runs from April until the middle of October. After that the crossing is left to a small mail boat, which carries letters and, if there is room, two or three passengers.

Islanders plan the winter around that boat. Heavy goods, from timber to washing machines, arrive in September, and a family that forgets to order fuel before the last ferry pays for a helicopter or waits until spring.

questions.prompt: What happens after the middle of October?
choices: Only a small mail boat crosses
The island is closed to visitors
The ferry runs twice a week

questions.prompt: Why do islanders order heavy goods in September?
choices: Prices are lower at the end of summer
The last ferry can still carry them
The mail boat refuses large parcels
